## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Outcome

Describe the resulting behavior, including before/after behavior when useful.

## Validation

Describe how the change was validated against the Issue's expected outcome.

## Related issues

Link the Issue(s) this PR addresses. Use closing keywords only for fully resolved Issues.

## Scope check

- [ ] This PR fully addresses each Issue it claims to resolve.
- [ ] This PR does not include unrelated work.
- [ ] This PR does not add speculative abstractions, extensibility, frameworks, or subsystems that are not needed by the Issue.
- [ ] Any intentionally partial implementation is clearly stated, and the parent Issue is not presented as fully resolved unless the remaining scope has been explicitly split out.
- [ ] Validation maps to the Issue's expected outcome / acceptance criteria.
